notes: Multi-turn scenarios for the memory work (design doc 5.11). Each scenario is one conversation; turns are sent in order with the conversationId the server returns. expect.cites_any: at least one citation's file or display name contains one of these substrings (case-insensitive). expect.answer_must_include: substrings of the answer. expect.mode_in: the answer mode must be one of these. expect.not_abstain: the answer must not be a 'documents don't cover this' reply. family: follow-up (Phase 2), carry-over, isolation, forget-correct, administration (later phases).

turns.message: Which documents cover the internship program?
How many credits does the teacher education program require?
What does the Operations Playbook cover?
Give me its three most important points as bullets
